text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out shopping...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Symboli Rudolf coming out of a
nearby
shop and call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't this a coincidence. Doing
some
shopping too, are you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I just finished placing an order for towels
and am
about to head over to my next
destination.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to increase the inventory of
towels that
the student council lends out
to students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's forecast to storm all next week, and
there's
sure to be an increase in students
who need
towels, thus the preemptive
restock.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Once I finish ordering extra umbrellas
and rain
gear, we'll be fully prepared for
whatever may
come.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

choice_data_list: Thanks, now rainy days won't be a problem.

Good work. You seem to have a lot on your plate for the academy.
Good work. You seem to have a lot on your plate for the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Feel free to be more generous
with
your compliments. They'll help
encourage me to
work with true altruism.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wish to make the academy a place
where all
students can pursue their
dreams wholeheartedly,
rain or shine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you have any requests of any sort,
please do
not hesitate to ask me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing. I was already in the area on
student
council business, so I decided to
kill two birds
with one stone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I have the duty of improving the
training
conditions for everyone, so it's
only natural that I
do all this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I need to make sure the drainage on the
track is
adequate once I'm finished
ordering everything...
I'd best hurry. No
time to waste.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I have a lot to learn from how

responsible and proactive Symboli
Rudolf is.
